about.title: Who is Andres Enrique Ortiz Santa Cruz?
about.bio1: Hello, I'm Andres Enrique Ortiz Santa Cruz, a *Backend-oriented Full-Stack developer*.
about.bio2: I design and build web applications and services with *TypeScript, Node.js and React*, with a particular interest in *software architecture, distributed systems, AI and cybersecurity*.
about.utezDegree: University Technician in multiplatform software development.
about.orleansDegree: IT B.U.T (Bac +3) - Realization of applications: design, development, validation.
about.hobbiesText: Doing what you love is essential to maintain a balance between physical and mental health. That's why I prioritize some of my time to do my hobbies, as they not only help me stay fit and healthy, but also improve my mood, reduce stress and relax me. This gives me an escape from the daily hustle and bustle and allows me to forget about everything for a moment and clear my head.
